WITH equipment_averages AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
), reference_averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS all_equipment_avg
  FROM equipment_averages
), kept_equipment AS (
  SELECT ea.equipref, ea.avg_humidity, ra.all_equipment_avg,
         ea.avg_humidity - ra.all_equipment_avg AS excess_humidity
  FROM equipment_averages ea
  CROSS JOIN reference_averages ra
  WHERE ra.all_equipment_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND ea.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
    AND ea.avg_humidity > ra.all_equipment_avg
), kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS kept_avg_humidity
  FROM kept_equipment
)
SELECT ke.equipref,
       ke.avg_humidity,
       ke.excess_humidity,
       ke.avg_humidity - km.kept_avg_humidity AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM kept_equipment ke
CROSS JOIN kept_mean km
WHERE km.kept_avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
